scope: Owner-requested refinement of the gold-star criteria: "Under 9, overdraw needs to be specifically analyzed, it is a big issue in the current games so far. Refine criteria". Claude added a numbers-only overdraw meter (scripts/probe_overdraw.gd: live Canvas tree plus a GPU layer count read from a real Mobile-renderer frame and discarded, proven exact by a self-test) and tools/measure_overdraw.py, measured the Mermaid Pool in its real castle room and all fifteen Opera careers through their real room routes, and wrote six overdraw checks (OD1-OD6) under C7 into the rubric with starting budgets and a hash-bound classification of every code-drawing script seen on screen. tools/gold_star.py now derives the checks from the measurements, caps C7 at 1 until they all pass, requires the core criteria (C1, C3, C4, C5, C6) at 2 for a 4/5, and ends every --compare with the ordered list that lifts the game to 4/5, then 5/5. The analysis found overdraw on the reference game's screen from shared room layers, so the Pool drops from 4/5 to 3/5 (MA-VIS-008, new P1); sixteen assessments made stale by Codex's Chef overdraw repair (f07c1a48) were re-assessed and rebound. The Codex handoff gains GS5 and owner questions 5-6 (packet revision 4).

lessons.lesson: A node-level meter cannot see what code-drawn content covers, and most Opera career art is drawn inside _draw functions; only a GPU layer count sees it, and it must be proven exact by a self-test before any number is trusted.

Measuring a screen means using the child's real route: a directly launched career kept the castle drawn over it, a frozen main kept the room transition up, and a story clip covered the room; each gave plausible but wrong numbers.

The reference game's own code was clean, but shared room layers drew a wash over Roshan; a check that only tests a game's own code (like the counter-tint arithmetic) misses what shared layers draw on its screen.

strengths_observed.evidence: Codex's Chef repair at f07c1a48 made sixteen gold-star assessments stale on the next check; each was re-assessed against the changed functions before rebinding, and Chef's C8 rose only where the evidence changed.
